mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_reports (user_id, report_date, done, plan, blockers, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{date}, #{done}, #{plan}, #{blockers}, #{status}) AS v ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE done = v.done, plan = v.plan, blockers = v.blockers, status = v.status, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)

INSERT INTO daily_reports (user_id, report_date, done, plan, blockers, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{date}, #{done}, #{plan}, #{blockers}, #{status}) ON CONFLICT(user_id, report_date) DO UPDATE SET done = excluded.done, plan = excluded.plan, blockers = excluded.blockers, status = excluded.status
INSERT IGNORE INTO daily_report_projects (report_id, project_id) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{projectId})
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO daily_report_projects (report_id, project_id) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{projectId})
